# kcore_vm (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kcore_vm" "existing" {
  id = var.vm_id
  # Optional hint when the controller needs disambiguation:
  # target_node = "10.0.0.5:9091"
}

output "vm_node_id" {
  value = data.kcore_vm.existing.node_id
}

output "vm_assigned_ip" {
  value = data.kcore_vm.existing.assigned_ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) VM ID

### Optional

- `target_node` (String) Optional node address hint for the controller lookup

### Read-Only

- `assigned_ip` (String) Controller-assigned VM IP when available
- `cpu` (Number) Number of CPU cores
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp
- `desired_state` (String) Declarative desired state from spec
- `disk` (List of Object) Disk configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disk))
- `memory_bytes` (Number) Memory in bytes
- `name` (String) Name of the VM
- `nic` (List of Object) Network interface configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nic))
- `node_id` (String) Node ID where the VM is running
- `state` (String) Current state of the VM
- `storage_backend` (String) VM storage backend (filesystem, lvm, zfs)
- `storage_size_bytes` (Number) Provisioned storage size in bytes

Read-Only:

- `backend_handle` (String)
